recentItems.title: These Women Changed Their Life For The Better | Everything I Gained, Love Me | Channel 4
recentItems.description:
Four women tell their story of how they changed their life.  Each woman sits down to reflect about their own journey by writing themselves a letter to their past self. Meet India, Gaynor, Jemma and Nicola. These are inspiring stories of people finding their confidence over time through transformative and sustainable weight management.

India talks about her previous relationship with food and how her weight meant she was hiding away. From yoyo dieting to feeling like she lost her identity after having kids, India decided to make healthier choices after having her second child and now she and her family live a happy and healthy lifestyle. 

Gaynor transformed her life; from being 21 stone to a bodybuilder at 58-Years-Old. 

Jemma really turned her life around. After being diagnosed with diabetes she reached out for help and learned how to cut out food noise and over time ended up losing 5 stone. 

Nicola talks about her old unhealthy snacking habits; from a bag of Haribo’s a day to a tub, but now she’s an ultramarathon runner.

The real transformation isn’t the weight that is lost, it’s the person that shows up for themselves - every story deserves to be celebrated.
